institution: Politechnika Gdańska / Gdańsk University of Technology, Faculty of Electronics, Telecommunications and Informatics
program: Sound and Vision Engineering (Inżynieria dźwięku i obrazu) — specialisation of MSc Electronics and Telecommunications
qualification: Magister inżynier (MSc) — but the English-taught MSc does NOT carry this specialisation
accreditationStatus: CAUTION. The Multimedia Systems Department runs a research & education specialisation called Sound and Vision Engineering, taught at Gdańsk Tech for over 25 years. HOWEVER the English-taught 'Master of Science in Electronics and Telecommunications' page lists only two specialisations: 'Radio Communication Systems and Networks' and 'Computer Electronic Systems'. Sound and Vision Engineering is NOT offered in the English-taught MSc — it exists only within Polish-taught programmes.
language: Polish for the Sound & Vision specialisation; English only for the two other specialisations
durationEcts: English MSc: 2 years / 4 semesters / 120 ECTS, or 1.5 years / 3 semesters / 90 ECTS
whatYouStudy: Acoustics, audio signal processing, multimedia systems, psychoacoustics, sound and image engineering — an ENGINEERING degree, not record-production/studio craft
entryRequirements: VERBATIM (English MSc): 'For 3-semester program: Electronics and Telecommunications, Informatics and obtaining a minimum of 210 ECTS points at BSc studies'; 'For 4-semester program: Electronics and Telecommunications, Automatics and Robotics, Informatics, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Technical Physics, Mechatronics, other related fields (strong background in mathematics and physics)'
acceptsNonMusic: YES — explicitly an engineering entry route. A BSc Software Engineering fits 'Informatics'. No music background required or wanted.
auditionSpec: NONE. No audition, no ear-training exam, no production test. Admission is on academic transcript.
tuitionNonEU: 10,000 PLN per semester for non-EU citizens on the English-taught MSc E&T (≈ €2,340/semester, ≈ €4,680/year at 4.27 PLN/EUR). Range across Gdańsk Tech master's programmes is 9,000–10,750 PLN/semester. EU citizens pay nothing.
otherFees: UNVERIFIED (application fee not stated on the tuition page)
totalCostEstimate: ≈ €9,400 tuition for a 2-year English MSc plus living costs; but the Sound & Vision specialisation is not available in English
scholarshipName: NAWA Banach Scholarship Programme (Poland) — UNVERIFIED whether Tunisia is currently eligible; NAWA Łukasiewicz programme is closed (last call 2020)
languageRequirement: English for the English-taught MSc; Polish for Sound & Vision Engineering
englishTest: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL or equivalent typically required — UNVERIFIED exact threshold on the official page
deadline: UNVERIFIED — 'Dates and deadlines' section not retrieved
verdict: EXCLUDE for this candidate's goal — the audio specialisation is Polish-only, and even in Polish it is an electronics degree, not record-making. Listed here because it was on the search brief and the negative finding matters.
